low-investigator.description: Cheap, fast lookups and narrow investigations (one hypothesis, one code path, one query).

investigator.description: Deeper root-cause work or exploring one solution end to end.

reviewer.description: Independent code review of a diff or PR (review-pr skill). Reads, never edits.

worker.description: The implementer: builds a change in its own worktree and verifies it locally, including running the stack.

env-builder.description: Sets up a known environment in a shared pig-env VM (dependencies, databases, a setup script) so other agents can use it. Runs the project's documented setup command if there is one and reports its output; does not improvise around failures.

advisor.description: Only for a decision or direction when stuck, or when the only working option is an ugly solution. Give it the options and evidence; it recommends, it doesn't implement.
